title: Purity-certified same-window verification for NIDS under label delay: code and result snapshots
description: Code and result snapshots for experiments on network intrusion detection when analyst labels arrive several windows late. A small part of each window's labelling budget is verified at once and spent on clusters of the flows the model calls benign; a cluster is raised only when r uniformly drawn members are all attacks. The archive contains the stream builders, the experiment runner and stages, the analysis scripts, unit tests and the per-run metrics behind every reported number. The datasets (NetFlow v3 releases, CIC-IDS2017, CIDDS-001) are public and not included.
